description: This file implements HTTP proxy connection handling for gRPC internal transport, including establishing TCP connections, performing HTTP CONNECT handshakes, and handling proxy authentication.

classes.name: bufConn
classes.description: A wrapper around net.Conn that uses a bufio.Reader to prevent losing buffered bytes during HTTP response reading.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffered reader within bufConn.

methods.name: basicAuth
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded Basic Authentication string from username and password.

methods.name: doHTTPConnectHandshake
methods.description: Performs an HTTP CONNECT handshake over a net.Conn, verifying the response and handling buffered data.

methods.name: proxyDial
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection and performs an HTTP CONNECT handshake to set up a proxy connection.

methods.name: sendHTTPRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over a net.Conn, attaching the provided context.
